om de databestanden in te lezen hebben we readr nodig, die hier wordt ingeladen.
als je deze nog niet hebt moet je de lijn install.packages("readr") runnen.
```{r}
install.packages("readr")
library(readr)
```



```{r}

file <- read.csv("../../raw_data/heartrate_1.csv")
file
subset_file <- file[2:3]
subset_file
subset_file <- subset_file[3:length(subset_file$Sport),]
colnames(subset_file)<- c("Time", "HR (bpm)")
subset_file

```

```{r}
read_and_filter <- function(filelocation) {
file <- read.csv("../../raw_data/heartrate_1.csv")
subset_file <- file[2:3]
subset_file <- subset_file[3:length(subset_file$Sport),]
colnames(subset_file)<- c("Time", "HR (bpm)")
return(subset_file)
}

read_and_filter("../../raw_data/heartrate_1.csv")

```
